title: TypeScript Type Definition Generator
description: Generate TypeScript type definitions and interfaces in src/lib/types/ with TypeScript support and export configuration.

name.description: Name of the type definition (e.g., User, Product, ApiResponse). Uses PascalCase naming conventions.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this type definition?

package.description: Subdirectory within src/ where types are created (default: 'lib' creates src/lib/types/)

projectName.description: Target project name where type will be generated. Auto-creates feature if not found.

directory.description: Override the entire directory path for type creation

file.description: Optional: Create or append type to existing file instead of creating separate file

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)

export.description: Export the generated type from project root src/index.ts (default: true)
